summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K to provide notice of redemption for its $1 billion 1.750% Fixed Rate/Floating Rate Senior Unsecured Notes due 2027. The issuer elected to redeem the entire outstanding principal in accordance with the indenture terms. The redemption date is 24 July 2026 at par (100% of principal amount), plus accrued interest from 24 July 2025 to the redemption date, payable to holders of record as of 9 July 2026. This is a routine debt redemption, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, no advisor involvement, and no strategic event. The filing simply executes contractual call provisions on outstanding bonds.
